function.name: requests_get
function.description: Sends a GET request to the specified URL to retrieve weather data from the Open-Meteo API. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

url.description: URL of the Open-Meteo API endpoint.

headers.description: Headers to include in the request. Each key-value pair represents a header field and its value.

Content-Type.description: The MIME type of the body of the request (used with POST and PUT requests).

Accept.description: Media type(s) that is/are acceptable for the response.

timeout.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for the server to send data before giving up. This is a float type value.

params.description: Query parameters for the GET request.

latitude.description: Latitude of the location, positive for N and negative for S. This is a float type value.

longitude.description: Longitude of the location, positive for E and negative for W. This is a float type value.

elevation.description: Elevation in meters above sea level for the location. The default value represents no elevation downscaling.

auth.description: Authentication tuple for HTTP authentication, in the format (username, password).

cert.description: Path to the SSL client certificate file (.pem). A null value means no client certificate is used.

cookies.description: Dictionary of cookies to send with the request. Each key represents a cookie name.

proxies.description: Dictionary mapping protocol names to the URL of the proxy. Each key-value pair represents a protocol and its proxy URL.

stream.description: If True, the response should be streamed; otherwise, it should be downloaded immediately.

verify.description: Whether to verify the server's TLS certificate.

• **3‑Day Pass** – $199 (valid for any three consecutive days)
• **5‑Day Pass** – $399 (valid for all five days)
• **VIP Experience** – $799 (includes backstage access, premium seating, exclusive lounge, and a meet‑and‑greet with select artists) | | **Ticket Purchase** | Tickets go on sale **August 15, 2025** (early‑bird) and **September 1, 2025** (regular). Purchase via the official website or authorized resellers. | | **Website** | https://www.summerfest.com | | **Social Media** | Instagram: @summerfest
Twitter: @Summerfest
Facebook: /Summerfest | --- ### 📅 Quick Timeline | Date | Event | |------|-------| | **Aug 15 2025** | Early‑bird ticket sales begin | | **Sep 1 2025** | Regular ticket sales begin | | **Oct 2025** | Full lineup announced | | **Jun 20 2026** | Your current date | | **Jul 27 – Jul 31 2026** | Summerfest 2026 takes place | --- ### 🚗 Getting There | Mode | Details | |------|---------| | **Car** | Take I‑94 E to exit 58 (Milwaukee). Follow signs to Riverfront Park. | | **Public Transit** | MBTA’s “M” bus line stops at the park. | | **Bike** | 10‑mile bike route from downtown Milwaukee; bike‑share stations available. | | **Shuttle** | Free festival shuttles run from downtown Milwaukee to the park during event days. | --- ### 🎟️ Tips for Attendees 1. **Buy tickets early** – Prices increase as the event approaches. 2. **Plan your schedule** – The lineup is released in stages; create a personalized itinerary. 3. **Pack smart** – Bring a reusable water bottle, a small backpack, sunscreen, and a light rain jacket. 4. **Stay hydrated** – Water stations are available throughout the park. 5. **Use the festival app** – Real‑time stage schedules, artist bios, and map navigation. 6. **Explore the food stalls** – Try the “Taste of Milwaukee” food trucks for local specialties. 7. **Check the weather forecast** – Milwaukee can be unpredictable in late July; plan accordingly. --- ### 🎉 Why Summerfest? - **Largest music festival in the world** – 5 days, 800+ artists, 1.5 million attendees. - **Economic impact** – Generates ~$200 million in local revenue each year. - **Cultural celebration** – Showcases diverse music styles and community events. - **Family‑friendly** – Activities for all ages, making it a great outing for couples, friends, and families alike. --- **Ready to experience the biggest music celebration of the summer?** Grab your tickets, plan your itinerary, and get ready for an unforgettable five‑day musical journey in Milwaukee!
